dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave curvature following a smooth spline from the posterior insertion point to the apex along the trailing edge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a small pixel radius at the morphological peak.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Moderate linear incline relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the visible dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Broad base width to vertical height ratio, approximately 1.8:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple small, white punctate markings distributed across the lateral surface of the fin and dorsal flank; no significant trailing edge notches or traumatic indentations detected.
other_distinctive_markers: Darker, vertically-oriented mottled pigmentation patch visible on the central lateral surface of the dorsal fin.
